title: The Choice Factory: 25 Behavioural Biases That Influence What We Buy

contents: A day of decisions: each of 25 short chapters catches one bias operating in an ordinary moment, from the morning commute to the evening shop
The roster runs from the fundamental attribution error, social proof, and charm pricing to the pratfall effect, the curse of knowledge, and the peak-end rule
Each chapter: the classic experiment, Shotton's own field replication or test, and the practical application for marketers
The closing argument: behavioural science as the advertising industry's overdue return to evidence

audiences: Founders and product people who write their own copy
Alchemy readers wanting the evidence-first companion
Consumers curious what is being run on them
